connector.name: Clipia
connector.registryDescription: Generate AI images, video, speech, music and presentations from Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.clipia.ai over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the clipia-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Clipia API key from the Developer Console (https://clipia.ai/en/developer). Format: 'Bearer clipia_...'. The endpoint also supports OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) for claude.ai and ChatGPT — no key needed there.
